author: Ashish Gupta — Digital Builders

phase1.name: Phase 1 — The Mystery Build
phase1.prompt: Extremely close-up, shallow depth of field. Two Indian hands are holding a dark matte black sci-fi mechanical egg (with segmented panels, a silver latch, and a crescent moon symbol on the left side) at chest height. A left thumb explicitly presses a circular button indent at the bottom of the egg. The camera slowly pulls back and tilts downwards as the hands gently lower the egg to rest perfectly upright on a highly reflective grey marble ledge. Once placed, the right hand completely withdraws from the frame. Background: Giant Adiyogi Shiva statue heavily blurred in soft bokeh under an overcast daylight sky. 9:16 vertical orientation, photorealistic cinematic lighting, continuous fluid motion.
phase1.negativePrompt: text, watermark, low quality, distortion, hard cuts

phase2.name: Phase 2 — Lingodbhava Transformation
phase2.prompt: The black sci-fi mechanical egg rests statically on the reflective marble ledge. Suddenly, its vertical seam panels mechanically fold outward laterally like the opening petals of a mechanical lotus flower. Simultaneously, a cross-shaped stabilizer base deploys with four rectangular extensions pointing outwards. As the panels flare wide open, a vertical telescoping rod rises straight up from the center core. From within this core, a miniature black Adiyogi Shiva bust (a serene male face with matted hair and a white teardrop tilak on the forehead) slowly emerges upward. The camera is locked low near ground level. The background features the giant Adiyogi statue in soft bokeh. Photorealistic, exact mechanical physics simulation, continuous smooth transformation, no human hands.
phase2.negativePrompt: jarring cuts, human hands, cartoon, low quality, morphing artifacts, text, watermark

phase3.name: Phase 3 — Hero Hold & Awakening
phase3.prompt: The mechanical panels completely fold back, fully revealing a flawless miniature black Adiyogi Shiva bust on the marble ledge. The bust seamlessly finishes assembling: large circular hoop earrings, a pearl bead necklace, and a prominent white crescent moon symbol materializing on its forehead. Directly beneath the bust, a miniature temple architecture base with pillars and a gopuram completes its formation. The miniature bust and temple base sit perfectly centered, echoing the massive real Adiyogi Shiva statue blurred majestically in the background on the exact same vertical axis. The camera performs a very slow, subtle cinematic push-in on the miniature bust. Overcast sky, photorealistic depth of field, steady and reverent composition.
phase3.negativePrompt: abrupt movement, low quality, static empty background, text, watermark

ambient.name: Courtyard Ambience
ambient.prompt: Deep silence, outdoor temple-courtyard ambience, distant gentle breeze, faint birds, and a distant resonant temple bell (Shankha) sounding once.

transformation.name: Damaru Build
transformation.prompt: Low ominous drone building up tension, subtle Damaru (Shiva's drum) rhythm begins slowly and builds up with a rising bass undertone, mystical and tense, three mechanical lock-clicks, then sudden silence.

music.name: Divine Swell
music.prompt: Majestic awe-inspiring devotional score, sudden divine swell of an Om Namah Shivaya ambient chant layered with a Tibetan singing bowl and a Carnatic nadaswaram burst, ending on a single long fading resonant OM bell.
